scope: Read-only source interpretation; no native result expansion, successor selection, algorithm modification or execution release.

findings.finding: Existing warm_start_mix selects several previous final-population members by k-center using old costs, shifts tails, renoises and denoises again, and separately scores fresh and adapted pools before a reward-quantile acceptance gate. It is not a one-selected-plan carryover mechanism, and its additional work cannot be assumed equal to the frozen 176-candidate/11-batch contract.

The inspected memory payload contains population, costs, Stage and global_step. It does not itself bind tracked target identity/generation or an exact eight-action completion. These would require explicit design and evidence for any new stateful mechanism.
Current N5/N7-compatible configuration guards require fresh population and zero chunk memory. Toggling the existing warm-start option is not an admissible in-place change to the active cohort.

interpretation: This is an implementation constraint inventory only. Observed differences from unexecuted model tails do not establish physical regression or memory efficacy; no new candidate is selected.
